The pass is done on the lean pilot only. Arabic RTL is not fixed, and there are no audio fades.

**What I changed**
- **Arabic text layers (5):** font set to "Noto Sans Arabic", text align set to right, box behavior set to auto-width. The five strings are exactly as you specified.
- **Opening scene:** removed the incoming fade from the first scene.
- **Narration track:** renamed it "Narration_TEMP_AR (TEMPORARY test voice - NOT Owner voice)". I applied a compressor of -24 dB threshold, 2:1 ratio, 0.15 s attack and 0.4 s release.
- **Music track:** renamed it "Music: Ambiment — Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 3.0".
- **Left alone:** the historical composition, 1920x1080, 30fps, narration duration (41.74 s), assets, voices, export and publish.

**Unresolved**
- **Arabic RTL (CAPABILITY_GAP):** there is no native direction or bidi property on text layers. I tried one pass with Unicode right-to-left isolates around each string and left-to-right isolates around the numerals. The render still showed the words in left-to-right order, for example "ساعة؟ 24 اليوم أن قرر من". I reverted the layers to the clean originals, which stay editable. I did not manually reverse any letters.
- **Font:** the render looked unchanged after I set Noto Sans Arabic, so I can't confirm that font is the one drawing. The layer accepted the setting.
- **Wrapping and right-alignment:** I didn't check these. The text is still sitting left of its panel, so right-aligned placement is unconfirmed.
- **Fades:** the editor has no audio fade property, so the 0.5 s music fade-in, 1.0 s fade-out and short SFX fades are not applied. The music bed is at 0.04 gain and the SFX are at 0.25, so narration stays dominant.
- **Loudness:** there is no LUFS or true-peak normalization or measurement here. The compressor only evens out levels. I measured nothing, so I'm not claiming -14 LUFS or ≤-1 dBTP.
- **Project notes:** there is no project-notes feature. The temporary-voice and music-attribution notes live only in the track names above.
